data.assumption: I interpreted “store” as showroom and “today” as payment_attempts.business_date = 2026-09-10, counting failed non-test payment attempts.
data.sql:
SELECT showroom_id, showroom_name, value
FROM (
  SELECT
    s.showroom_id,
    s.name AS showroom_name,
    COUNT(*) AS value,
    MAX(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS max_value
  FROM payment_attempts pa
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
  JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
  WHERE pa.is_test IS FALSE
    AND o.is_test IS FALSE
    AND pa.business_date = DATE '2026-09-10'
    AND pa.status = 'failed'
  GROUP BY s.showroom_id, s.name
) ranked
WHERE value = max_value
